name: com.tencent.bugly.beta.tinker.TinkerResultService
description: Tencent Bugly Beta and the Tencent Cloud Tinker wrapper use this service after a Tinker patch finishes. It reports patch success or failure, removes the downloaded patch file, and may restart the app so a successful patch takes effect.
disableEffect: Patch completion callbacks and restart handling may stop, so an installed fix may not become active.
